phase: Accounting Empirical Recovery / F4 Phase C — Immutable-Source Partial Materialization
purpose: Retain the exact successful F4 Phase B evidence and materialize only the unconditional rank-unique 2025 F4 cells into a separate partial artifact without modifying the canonical benchmark.

classification.OBSERVED: Stock cell directly represented by the selected exact QSA all-maturity position series in Phase A.

classification.UNRESOLVED: In-boundary F4 cell with non-zero loading on at least one unconditional Phase B nullspace vector, or a cell made unique only by the conditional BNR zero-liability stock scenario.
classification.NOT_APPLICABLE: X→X, outside the Romanian national financial-accounts boundary.

promotion_rule: The separate partial-F4 artifact may be retained as empirical recovery evidence. The canonical total F4 matrix remains incomplete and benchmark_2025.json remains unchanged until a later gate resolves or formally accepts the remaining degrees of freedom.
